author: Codex
publication_base: PR18 9ba6209; parallel to Pro PR19 AE1 background, both follow PR16. AE1 is not rerun or pooled as independent evidence here
source: Unmodified P030 Model class AST extracted from the pinned public source, without executing/importing its old main
input: Q='01'+two op information bits+'0'+three value information bits+'0'; only binary Q plus current answer prefix enters Model
answer: Echo op0 copies three information bits; Neg op1 flips those bits; both append tail0, then external target S
diagnostic_status: Both values already exposed in prior research. Neither is a training input operand here, but their bit patterns occur in Neg teacher answers: input1 gives110, input2 gives101. Report heldout as exposed diagnostics, not a new blind test

schedule.value_stream: For each seed/op, default_rng(seed+121000+op), concatenate200 independently permuted complete cycles of [0,1,2,3,4,7]. Both arms use exactly this same1200-value stream per op
schedule.early_prefix: default_rng(seed+122000): first rng.permutation([0,1]), then rng.permutation([0]*599+[1]*599), concatenate to1200 lessons
schedule.shared_tail: default_rng(seed+124000).permutation([0]*600+[1]*600),1200 lessons. Both arms have consumed600 values per op at entry, so actual tail(op,value) streams match exactly
schedule.control: Prefix totals each E600/N600, final E1200/N1200; within-op whole value order, per-op/value exposure, initial fullstate and final1200 actual lessons are exactly paired. Only prefix opcode timing differs

optimizer: Original Model.lesson/step/loss_grad/forward unchanged: Adam lr.003 beta.9/.999 eps1e-8, global gradient norm clip1, float32 parameters/moments and original birth-age correction; no growth, router, separator or extra task
initialization: Fresh original Model(seed,L13,H69), all full p/m/v/birth/t/growth_rng plus seed/events/counters frozen in the input ZIP and shared by early/late
execution_order: Finish all six primary trajectories, then six complete replays from the same frozen initial states, then offline inference for all16 legal Q at all four checkpoints. Training points store state only; no scores influence training
replay: Primary original Model.lesson is observed per target; replay independently calls original Model.step on the fixed true prefixes. Exact target metadata/prediction/loss/fullstate hash/counters each update, and direct p/m/v/birth/t/RNG/events/counters at every checkpoint and final state
primary_endpoint: Final per-op train and diagnostic whole generation, TF data bits, tail0 and STOP; same-payload both-ops whole correct; exact wrong output equal to the other op's full answer including STOP. Retain all three paired seeds and both arms
opcode_probe: At first output (empty A prefix), compare each value's two full legal Q differing only in opcode bit. Reuse the cached first TF logits; raw predicted-token flip and both-correct-and-flip separately. This is conditional behavior, not evidence of an internal router
generation: Original8-action cap, L13 overflow guard, no forced STOP, no answer length supplied
stop: Exactly2400 lessons/12000 updates for every student. No early stop, score-based extension, extra seed, best checkpoint selection, restart or config change
gate: Only synthetic engineering and preparation before source/input review and Git preregistration. Formal execute requires exact approved manifest SHA, supplied preregistration commit and a new output directory
costs: Training dense MAC matched. Offline inference MAC/calls, replay, p/m/v/birth array bytes, trace/storage and walltime separately reported; equal training MAC is not equal total cost
limits: A bounded three-bit timing policy comparison on an already examined domain. Does not establish unbounded copying/flipping, task routing, general growth, causal isolation of Neg semantics or a new blind generalization result
